From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2029 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Medisync kickoff — week-zero availability matrix & attendee roles

Hi Julia / Samir,

Thanks again for agreeing to Week 0 next week. To keep the kickoff efficient, I put together a short availability grid and a proposed attendee/role pairing so we can lock a 60-minute session that covers onboarding, SSO checks, and an initial runbook review. Attached: a 1-page agenda and an attendee matrix (.csv) that maps owners to topics.

Proposed 60-minute windows (I included both local and UTC times):
- Option A: Tue, Jun 25 — 09:00–10:00 ET / 14:00–15:00 BST / 13:00–14:00 UTC
- Option B: Tue, Jun 25 — 16:00–17:00 ET / 21:00–22:00 BST / 20:00–21:00 UTC
- Option C: Wed, Jun 26 — 08:00–09:00 ET (early) — useful if your IT needs a morning slot for SAML verification

Please reply with the option that works best and who will attend from Medisync in these roles:
- Executive Sponsor (15 min intro)
- IT / SSO lead (SAML and SCIM check)
- Product/PO (success criteria and integration scope)
- Day-1 operator (who will own runbook/actions)

Internal attendees and proposed owners (subject to adjustment):
- Olga Petrov — Kickoff facilitator / agenda owner
- Mina Haddad — Implementation runbook & bridging plan
- Logan Wright — Engineering lead for SSO/Network checks
- Rishi Malhotra — Customer success / commercial touchpoint

If none of those slots work, tell me two 1-hour windows in ET and I will convert to your timezone. I’ll send a calendar invite as soon as we confirm and include a Zoom link and pre-read.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890 (passcode: RWKickoff)

Agenda (60 min):
- 0–10m: Exec intro & success metrics (Julia)
- 10–25m: Implementation scope & milestones (Priya / Olga)
- 25–40m: SSO/SAML handoff + test plan (Samir / Logan)
- 40–50m: Day-1 operator walkthrough & runbook (Marcus / Mina)
- 50–60m: Action items, next steps & immediate blockers (All)

Pre-call asks (quick):
- Samir: if possible, upload SAML metadata and a test account to the Drive folder before the call. We’ll run the metadata validation live if time permits.
- Marcus / Priya: confirm that any scoped integration endpoints are accessible from your staging VPC; if not, flag in the Drive doc.

If anything changes, I’ll update the invite. Rishi — can you please own the billing/commercial intro portion at the end (~2–3 min)?

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Olga
